scope: Read-only local gap audit; no repository or remote mutation; no full test suite

findings.actual_result: Direct default-source check reports Framework drift; full sync required against active GongGong. This does NOT invalidate current published host binding.
findings.host_binding_evidence: .olympus-local.json explicitly binds .godot-integration-local/source-recovery-agent/framework relative to repository root; bridge.host_environment honors this binding.
findings.host_probe_result: ok=true; candidate integrity, formal framework admission, three local admissions and Hermes 32 records pass; blocking_checks=[]; model_execution_started=false; host_authority_authenticated=false
findings.minimum_action: Keep current pinned host binding, freshly verified by doctor. Prepare active-upstream full candidate in new directory, preserve Hermes exemption, verify full parity and new candidate admission before any switch. Direct default-source drift is an update backlog, not proof that the current release is broken.
findings.boundary: New candidate digests require applicable independent review and actual approval; never edit frozen originals or inherit previous approval automatically.

findings.actual_result: Existing CI checks Godot style/builds; no Olympus, Hermes git-check, or canonical Issue check found in workflow definitions. PR template only suggests Closes #.
findings.minimum_action: Add dedicated customization validator and CI status for canonical repository Issue, exactly one type label, linked design document, candidate-bound checks and committed Hermes events. Keep full-production admission distinct from offline contribution checks.
findings.boundary: Required status and branch protection/rulesets must be enforced remotely; local files alone cannot guarantee all contributors use Olympus. Remote rule state was not inspected by this audit.

findings.actual_result: Terminal receipt already uses asynchronous child process. Default _record_olympus still calls synchronous OS::execute for request/model/tool start and result paths.
findings.minimum_action: Use durable enqueue plus asynchronous receipt state machine. Resume model/tool continuations only after matching receipt. Keep generation cancellation and outbox recovery. Test slow/failing child, Stop, new session and retry; do not merely mark queued events delivered.
findings.boundary: The existing 100ms UI child-process completion timer is not an Ariadne/Sinan scheduled invocation. Its removal is not required by coordinator event-only policy.

findings.actual_result: Source registry empty; Ariadne disabled, host loader unimplemented, work-items ariadne_source_registered=false. Collection is local Hermes source indexing with explicit ingestion=false; sources.json explicitly indexes Issue 1 and 2 only. Later Issue snapshots exist separately.
findings.minimum_action: Custom event adapter receives actual Issue/PR events, keeps canonical remote identity and immutable payload/delivery IDs, performs idempotent materialization, invokes existing coordinator entry on actual events under current host binding, and records real collection/coordination receipts. No polling or time triggers.
findings.boundary: Source index is not Diting consumption. GitHub workflow, coordinator binding, and independent collector consumption need separate representative receipts; do not flip readiness booleans from configuration alone.
